reviews.text: food and atmosphere were lovely...they only had one waitress on for the entire evening ad 3 servers Rather strange but we had a nice evening

This was my second time going to the restaurant (first was back in Oct/Nov). I remembered it being a bit of a scene with good food and good enough service, so I went there with a buddy of mine last week who was in from out of town. The food was mediocre, the service was pretty decent but we were one of only three tables in the entire place. The menu was limited and there were no specials. My beef carpaccio tasted cooked (kind of roast-beefy) and my paella was very average. All-in-all I thought it was utterly mediocre when I was hoping for a cool and fun place with good food. Very disappointing given my first experience there. I will say, it was the Wednesday before Easter so maybe some folks were out of town but I see no reason to go back.
Everything was delish...but dessert is a let down. I would just forget dessert and fill up on their awesome entrees and apps and cocktails.
Very fair all in all, the menu is all over the place and the food is unrefined
Very nice restaurant, though a bit pricey. The food was very good except for a steak that was a bit fatty. Service was friendly and efficient. Beautiful interior design.
Food was very good. Had a little hard time with my reservation (I had a special coupon) but once we finally sat down to eat, very enjoyable.

The food simply wasn't good. Wasn't horrible, but you could probably cook the same dishes as well, if not better at home. Plus all of our courses were almost cold - luke warm at best. Aesthetically, its a cool place, but when they can't come through with quality food, you have to question why you're attending.
Great spot! Excellent food and waiter couldn't have been better. Went Friday night with fiance and we had a wonderful romantic dinner. I would highly recommend for a date spot.
they falsely charged more than what I gave them for tip. planning to call manager.

The tables in the front of the restaurant are freezing. We asked to move to a warmer area that had just opened, and the manager would only offer us the table in front of the door, which is the coldest in the restaurant. We had ordered a bottle of wine, and asked them not to open it until we changed tables. They kept stalling, asking us if we wanted some wine while they looked into the table move, which took 15 mins. They were very manipulative and rude. We walked out. I expect much better service in a restaurant that has +$30 entrees that don't include +$10 sides. Don't waste your money.
What a pleasant surprise. We came to the restaurant because of the Gilt City promotion. We each had our own tasting menu. Everything we ate was very well balanced, seasoned, and just delicious.

We enjoyed the food but I feel that it was over priced. The restaurant is nice inside, but the neighborhood is a bit questionable.
The service was very good. The pasta dishes from the tasting menu were good- 2 of them were realy good.
I simply think it is over priced.
This place was very disappointing. Service was terrible and it was freezing.

Went Jan. 20. Threw me off because they didn't have prices listed on their online menu but it's not too bad. Coatcheck girl was too cool for school and needs an attitude adjustment but the servers were great. The menus is not big which isn't a problem except that they were out of at least half the mains and half of the desserts. But, everything I ordered was absolutely delicious. It was a very hip little joint that borders pretentious but I loved it.

Beautiful space visually, wonderful job with the interior decorations. Many of the food items were amazing such as the ravioli stuffed with squash, while all others were decent, no bad remarks. Look forward to going again and have recommended to others.

I don’t write many reviews but felt like here I had to. The first time we came to this place was in the summer - loved it. Decided to go back with some friends. Despite having a reservation we waited 45 min. Menu selection is so slim we barely found things to eat. Come here if you want pasta, that’s basically all they have. Was way too noisy - badly mixed top 40's music. We asked the waitress to turn the music down a bit because it was late and the restaurant was getting empty ... they turned it up. Really not please. Def won’t ever be going back. Shame that another good restaurant bites the dust.
gets better and better every time there...food is now quite exceptional....only complaint is that they have a lousy beer list...short, unimaginative and boring
Ive been to over 200 restaurants in 2010, and this past weekend I went to Travertine and it's hands down my favorite place. Can't wait to go back.

Was a wonderful dinner at travertine. Would absolutely go again. Food was delicious. I felt the food was a little too quick to come out and you felt a bit rushed. We just ordered a couple of appetizers and then decided to order a pasta dish which gave us more time to sit and talk and enjoy what we had.
Very disappointing went for my wife's Bday the place was dead and the service still sucked they forget about a dessert no candle no anything pasta was awful literally felt sick would never go back

We were very unhappy with the food. Ordered a pasta with brown butter sauce. Sauce was a thick cream. Very different from description on menu. Asked specifically for the dish to be described and never did anyone say thick cream sauce with butter in it. It did not help that my dinning partner cannot eat cream sauce.
This new hot spot has great food in a great romantic setting. The decor and design of the restaurant is worthy of a magazine cover. I would highly recommend this fabulous restaurant to everyone.

I know there has been much hype about the late night scene here. We didnt stay for that, but did have a terrific meal. The layout of the place leaves a lot to be desired. It's a suprisingly small place upstairs in the restaurant area. The bar is much too cramped. There were only about 8 people waiting on tables but they jammed up the whole bar and it took forever for us to get a drink while waiting for the rest of our party to arrive. The food though was very impressive. Overall we had a great meal, and good service. The hostess had a bit too much attitude for our taste, but maybe she was getting ready for the hipsters soon to descend.
Loved the food. Really great choices, especially the pastas. Trendy and fun.
One of the best meals I've ever eaten. Handles food allergies/intolerances very well.

Pasta were delicious and original and service very friendly and helpful. The restaurant was designed like a hot spot, but there were few patrons that night so not particularly fun if you're a small group.

Our evening got off to a shaky start, since we had to wait over an hour for our table, despite having a reservation. This is a very small restaurant, and I really wouldn't recommend it for parties larger than 2 (we were 5 people). In any case, our waiter was very nice and once the food came, it was so delicious we almost forgot how long we'd waited!! We each had different appetizers, which we all shared, and pastas for the main course. Each dish was wonderful in its own way. The setting is beautiful, and very dark and romantic. So leave the groups for another place, take your date here and enjoy!!
We were seated 45 minutes late and the hostess was less than apologetic. Once we were seated everything was fabulous. We loved the Cod and truffle mashed potatoes. Will definitely be back!

This restraurant has obviously been discovered since we were first there in March of this year. We still loved the food, but it was extremely noisy and quite chilly. I would still go back again however. I was surprised it was so crowded for a Wednesday night.
Food was great, our waiter was excellent, but simply too noisy, would love to come back for lunch or earlier when the noise might be bearable.

Food was OK, but portions tiny and overpriced; the portion of salmon was tiny and expensive, though my friend who ordered the pork main seemed to fare slightly better. Ravioli was similarly tiny, though the Pici were tasty and probably the highlight of the meal. This would have been bearable if it weren't for the service. If you care more about what your waiter looks like than whether he can remember your order then this is the place for you. Our waiter forgot who had ordered what at the table several times and timing by the kitchen was awful. One of our entrees arrived 10mins after the others. Same thing with desserts when my friend's plate of cookies dessert arrive 10mins after the others. Far too much choice in NYC to bother returning.
The vibe, the food, the servive. It was perfect!

Excellent service and delicious food. The waiter's recommendations were spot on. Ordered a second glass of wine and he even topped off my husband's glass for no extra charge. They were extremely attentive and responsive. The air conditioning was on a little high and they adjusted it, at our request, and the manager and other wait staff made sure to follow up and made continued adjustments until we were satisfied. Great Cab Franc. Roasted mushrooms were excellent as well as pork dish. Will definitely go back!
I was blwon away by the quality of the food. I am sorry I didn't try it sooner. I also loved the reasonably priced wine I had as well as the unobtrusive, but attentive service. Bravo!

There's nothing wrong with the food, but it seems like they're now taking the lounge downstairs more seriously. Menu items were missing, and various substitutions for cheaper ingredients made without warning. The wait staff was very nice, but seemed only half aware of what was going on.
I think they had just recently opened, but they were out of everything my husband wanted on the menu and the service wasn't great.
one problem the noise from the cars on Kenmare ridiculous dont let them sit you by the tables near the street and those doors should definitely be closed food though more importantly EXCELLENT!!

This was our second dining experience at Travertine and it was as enjoyable as our first! The dining room is cool, modern, and elegant. The service was attentive without being overbearing. And the food was inventive, tasty, and portioned appropriately -- no super-sizing yet left the table feeling comfortably sated.

The food was not very memorable and not very organized.  At 6pm, the staff was still setting up for dinner.  If you have early reservations, don't expect to be let in for a drink at the bar.  They refuse to let you in and wait at the bar even with reservations.  Plus after sitting there for an hour, my leg was bit up by mosquitos.  Definitely not memorable at all
Trendy downtown spot with excellent (pricey) food and cool atmosphere.
The only issue is that when the front wall is open, the outside traffic noise is just too much.

Our meal was very well prepared, the pork loin was particularly good. Our server was very attentive. The only negative was the loud music. It is as if they're trying to generate some kind of clubby feel, which is neither necessary nor consistent with the look and feel of the space.
Good food and very nice staff. The pasta was a 10 !
the food was very good, however, 3 people were cramped into a table meant for two and the Air Conditioning was off for part of the mean making my dining experience very uncomfortable.
We thought the food and service were great.

poorly conceived dishes, a lot of things that just did not go well together...lack of seasoning...beef carpaccio with no taste at all other than the blue cheese

portion size small, price large...that's okay if well executed...and this was not.

menu reads better than it shows on the plate and palate
Great spot for small group. Elegant yet casual. Knowledgeable staff. Terrific menu.
Dinner was excellent! Great service.
Lovely setting. The quality of food served was very good. The portions were a bit small and the prices charged were high. Dinner for 3 with 1 bottle of wine was a shade under $300.

At 8pm we were only one of a few tables in the restaurant. I gather things pick up later in the evening. Food was exceptional. Pastas were delicious as was the pork tenderloin. Service was also quite good. The decor and ambiance were also outstanding. My only criticism and it's a major one...is the wine list. While there are some excellent selections on the list, it is severely lacking options in the $40-70 range. The bulk of the list contains wines well over $100 and not everyone wants to drop that on a bottle of wine with dinner. I'll still come back in because the food was that good, but wish they would round out the list a little more.
